text: Michael and Sam Emerson [move with their divorced mother to the seaside town of Santa Carla|trigger|making a new home], where the Frog brothers at the comic shop swear vampires have taken over. Drawn to Star on the boardwalk, Michael follows David's motorcycle gang to their buried hotel and, ignoring her warning, [drinks from a bottle of blood|trigger|breaking a rule]. Soon he shuns the light, his [reflection begins to fade|images|mirrors and glass], and he craves blood. Sam learns the change may be reversed only if [they kill the head vampire|rules|it has a fatal weakness].
